name: After the End
detailed_description:
Ragnarok came and went — but the end was only the beginning.
In After the End, you are a lone survivor wandering the scarred remnants of Midgard, a once-glorious realm now swallowed by ruin, silence, and the restless dead. The gods are gone. The world tree burns. What remains is up to you to piece back together.

Explore the desolate north, from ash-covered villages and frostbitten fjords to forgotten shrines and cursed barrows. Reclaim weapons of legend, commune with fading spirits, and choose your path in a world that remembers your every choice.

Forge your legend in a hand-crafted 2D RPG inspired by Norse myth and gritty survival. With weighty combat, branching quests, and ancient mysteries to uncover, After the End is a tale of endurance, memory, and the quiet hope that something better might yet grow from the ashes.

Features

  • ⚔️ Weighty, Tactical Combat – Time your strikes, roll to evade, and crush enemies with axes, blades, and runes of power.

  • 📜 Branching Quests & Lore – Shape the world through your choices. Aid broken villages, uncover ancient secrets, or walk away.

  • 🧠 Skill Trees of Steel & Spirit – Unlock abilities in The Way of Valor and The Way of the Seer to fit your survival style.

  • 🛠️ Inventory with Rune-Carved Gear – Equip and enhance armor and weapons with rare runes that twist your abilities.

  • 🌲 Hand-Crafted Pixel World – Explore hauntingly detailed ruins, mythic forests, and snow-laden reaches in a rich 2D top-down style.

  • 🐺 Deadly Foes & Creatures of Legend – Battle wraiths, Dökkálfar, Jötnar, and the undead that claw through Midgard’s bones.

  • 🔥 Journal UI Like a Saga – Flip through your character’s story with a dynamically animated journal: quests, skills, maps, and lore.

    🔶 Development Note

    After the End is in early development. All visuals, mechanics, and features are subject to change. There is currently no confirmed release date. This page exists to share progress, gather feedback, and build a community around the journey.

short_description: Explore the shattered world of Midgard in this 2D Viking RPG set after Ragnarok. Battle undead warriors, uncover ancient ruins, and carve your path through a land scarred by gods and giants. Survive, rebuild, and forge your saga in a broken world.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains depictions of violence, death, and unsettling themes. Combat includes blood effects and the use of weapons such as axes and swords. Some environments depict corpses, ruined villages, and supernatural horror elements inspired by Norse mythology.

While not overly graphic, the tone is somber and mature, dealing with loss, survival, and the aftermath of catastrophic events.
